name: design-tools
description: Discovery for design work on UI that already exists. Describe the task in your own words; it is run through eighty-seven design skills from fifteen vendors (ui-craft, taste-skill, impeccable, Emil Kowalski, Addy Osmani's web-quality suite, ibelick and nine smaller ones) and a ranked list comes back — each tool with what it would do for this task, whole-vendor options where one orchestrator would do, collision notes where two overlap. You pick; a ready-to-run prompt is written that loads exactly those tools from wherever they are installed (registry + resolver, so it works from any project) and uses them in the right order; run it now or later. Keeps one vendor-prefixed command per tool (/design-tools:ui-craft-typeset, /design-tools:osmani-seo, …), one entry per vendor that runs its master skill as the vendor designed it (/design-tools:impeccable, /design-tools:ui-craft, /design-tools:taste), a wiki of every vendor and tool, and /design-tools:demo for the design-studio dashboard.
